Usage: auggie [instruction] [options] Auggie — Augment CLI Agent. Run interactive or automated tasks in your terminal. Input [instruction] Positional instruction -i, --instruction Instruction (mutually exclusive with --instruction-file) --queue Queue additional instructions for sequential execution (repeatable, requires --print) -if, --instruction-file

Instruction file (mutually exclusive with --instruction) --image Image file(s) to attach (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP) --file File(s) to attach (PDF) --enhance-prompt Enhance the prompt before sending (requires --print) Output & Interaction -p, --print Print mode (one-shot). Note that the indexing confirmation prompt is skipped in print mode. Only use --print from a workspace root that you want to index. -q, --quiet Only show final assistant message --output-format Output format (only works with --print): "text" (default) or "json" --queue Queue additional instructions for sequential execution (repeatable, requires --print) -a, --ask Enable ask mode for retrieval and non-editing tools only --show-cost Show billing cost summary at end of --print session --no-update-terminal-title Disable automatic terminal title updates --mcp Run as MCP tool server --acp Enable ACP mode Configuration Options -m, --model Select model to use --reasoning-effort Set model reasoning effort for this session --persona Select agent persona to use -w, --workspace-root Workspace root (auto-detects git root if absent) --add-workspace Additional workspace directory to index (repeatable) --discover-workspaces[=depth] Force git-repo discovery under a non-git root; optional depth 1-5 (default 1, use =N for nested owner/repo) --no-discover-workspaces Disable git-repo auto-discovery entirely --rules Additional rules file (repeatable) --augment-cache-dir Cache directory (default: ~/.augment) --retry-timeout Timeout for rate-limit retries (seconds) --max-turns Limit the number of agentic turns (only works with --print) --allow-indexing Skip the indexing confirmation screen in interactive mode --wait-for-indexing Wait for workspace indexing to complete before codebase retrieval executes Session Options -c, --continue Continue from the most recent session -r, --resume [sessionId] Resume a specific session by ID or prefix (omit to pick interactively) --dont-save-session Do not save conversation history Authentication Options --augment-session-json Session JSON or path to session file for authentication --github-api-token Path to file containing GitHub API token Tools & Integrations --mcp-config MCP server configuration (repeatable) --permission Set tool permissions with 'tool-name:policy' format (repeatable) Command-line permissions take precedence over settings permissions Possible policies: allow, deny, ask-user, webhook-policy(url), script-policy(path) --remove-tool Remove a specific tool by name (repeatable) Command-line removed tools take precedence over settings --shell Select shell: bash | zsh | fish | sh | powershell --startup-script
